description: Numbers of the game camera (the fixed and following cameras of the original game, not the PC alt cameras of alt_cameras.json). Lengths are metres and angles degrees (+Y is down); the engine turns them into fixed point the way the game did (single-precision multiply, truncated toward zero), so the shipped values give the original's exact numbers. A mod's copy is merged over this file as a patch (JSON data merge); a key it leaves out keeps the shipped value.

view.description: draw_cull_margin: extra margin in screen units around the PC view for the drawing-side box test of map chunks. Game logic visibility tests always use the original 4:3 bounds and ignore it.

camera.description: default_watch: look-at motion of the automatic camera and of a script look-at given no parameters (accelerations and top speeds). user_camera: camera motion of a script camera target given no parameters, also used by the automatic follow camera; scripts may change these speeds at run time. watch_max_y: how far the look-at may rise. first_camera_distance / first_camera_height: at map start the camera sits this far behind and above the character.

subject.description: How the camera reads the character it follows. top_offset_y / bottom_offset_y: the height span above the feet (bottom scaled by the elevation rate). connected_ground_y / connected_head_y: ground and head while the character rides a scripted connection. ground_missing_y: the world's no-ground height, read as 0. eye_half_angle, watch_radius: the field of view and sight range the camera assumes for the subject. head_*: the head point in the head bone's frame, then raised.

debug_camera.description: The developer camera modes (orbit around a reference point, fly with the pad, orbit the head). start_radius: orbit radius when a map begins. turn_per_vblank is a raw Q12 angle step (4096 = full turn) per vertical blank (60 per second).

enemies.description: The characters the camera tracks as enemies (it turns to frame them in a fight), by name; always_active: those of them that stay an active camera target even when knocked down and not aimed at. A mod adds its own monster here.

map_rules.description: Per-map camera exceptions; each list given replaces the shipped list whole. Map types are tags of config/map_info.json ('TAG#n' = the n-th entry with that tag: 'ER#2' is the type of map7_*), maps are map names (map1_s02), rooms the save's room index. self_view_blocked: boxes (inclusive edges) where the self view never engages. tight_doorways: map types whose narrow doorways get the through-door rail camera tuning. road_anchor_shifts: on that map and room, each camera zone whose road area is the single point road_x / road_z has its anchor moved by shift_x. wide_shots: on that map and room, the fixed shot whose camera is within tolerance of the anchor turns its look-at by the angle the widescreen view adds, so the extra picture shows the dressed side of the set.
